evidence.excerpt: Todić spent four months in 2013 as a visiting researcher at a power supply manufacturer in Graz, Austria, where he contributed to gate-driver design reviews for a 1 kW server power supply product based on SiC MOSFETs. He has provided informal consulting to two Novi Sad-based electronics companies on PCB layout and EMC issues in switch-mode power supplies.
